title: The degree part of the Picard functor is an fpqc sheaf
statement: Let k be a field, f:C to Spec k a smooth proper geometrically integral curve, and d an integer. Let S be the subfunctor of the relative Picard presheaf whose classes have fibrewise degree d at every point [lem-pd-degree-locally-constant]. Its fppf sheafification is a sheaf also for the fpqc topology. This uses normalized invertible-module descent [lem-pc-fpqc-descent], the universally trivial direct image [lem-pc-rational-hyp], and the normalized splitting after a finite separable point extension [thm-pc-pic-split].

proof.text: Apply the existence and uniqueness lemmas for amalgamations over an fpqc sieve to the sheaf-valued family.
